chunks: And it has also been transmitted from him, peace be upon him and his family, that he commanded al-talaḥḥī and forbade al-iqtiʿāṭ.

key_terms.بِالتَّلَحِّي: wearing the turban in the prescribed manner
key_terms.ٱلِاقْتِعَاطِ: wrapping the turban without letting its end hang

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله command regarding wearing turbans and what style did he forbid?
ai.summary: This report states that the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله commanded a particular manner of wearing the turban and prohibited another style. In context, it serves as evidence for rulings on permissible dress and proper attire in acts of worship such as salat.
